clause: LAW-12 genesis clause, watch/inbox/BURN_rsi-harness_20260926.md falsifier: one scenario card per G1-G7 minted from real REGISTRY.jsonl FAIL rows within 14 days of registration
citation_provenance: Real fleet FAIL row: the first gate run of .zcode/workflows/mickey17-v2.dwf.ts at 2026-09-25T20:45:15Z returned verdict FAIL with G3-steering ok=false (alongside G4 and G7); the follow-up row at 20:47:59 shows the amend-to-PASS that the gate is designed to force.
scenario_description: A reviewer pass exists but its verdict goes nowhere: reviewer notes are appended to output with no revision ask, so reviewer findings never steer the work and the review is decoration.
regression_criterion: tools/workflow_gate.py check --scenarios configs/workflow_gate_scenarios exits 0 with this card green. The card goes red if (a) the gate stops flagging fail_g3.dwf.ts (G3 steering carries: reported these issues, Previous critique, or the .issues/.feedback/.comments/.critique ask-carriage regex weakened or removed), (b) the fixture starts failing gates beyond expected_verdict.failed_checks, or (c) the cited row disappears from REGISTRY.jsonl. Card and fixture are immutable inputs: a G3 semantics change requires a new dated card filed alongside, never a silent edit.
rollback_note: Scenario mode is read-only: it writes no registry row and touches no file. Rollback of a G3 gate change is a git revert of tools/workflow_gate.py to the pre-change blob, then re-run check --scenarios expecting green. The cited fleet FAIL row (line 3) and its PASS successor (line 4) are history and are never erased; the fixture stays so the reverted gate can be re-proven.
